### 结论速览

|---|---|
| X 批"E 入口走廊五件套少掷 +169" | **归因勘误**：五件套（爬升循环/roomDelay 支/GenerateHall/GenerateRoom/GenerateEntrance）逐掷 diff 全 1:1——15 轮爬升起点逐位同 k（i0@200..i14@218 与 oracle DG_CLIMB_TRACE 全等）、末厅 TileRunner(677,242,s33,st16) 主流消费逐位同（两侧出口都在 k=6660）。真根=**GenerateEntrance 条纹窗墙的 169 次 WorldGen.PlaceWall 调用，每次调用耗 1 颗主流骰**（vanilla 探针实证 169 连调用=k6661→6830 逐位 +1），oracle/JS 转写零耗 → E 段 -169 |

### 证据链（一手探针，可复跑）

1. **E 五件套逐掷 diff（两侧）**：新 DgZProbe（ZH=GenerateHall(3参)头、ZS=19 mark、ZT/ZTE=TileRunner 头/ret、ZN=NewNPC ret、ZP/ZQ=PlaceTile 头/ret、ZW=PlaceWall 头）注入 /tmp/dgu/TerrariaServer.dgz.exe（featpatch 同款 Cecil 管线，/tmp/dgu/zpatch）。vanilla 侧：15 轮爬升 hall 入口 (x,y,流哈希) 与 oracle DG_CLIMB_TRACE 逐位同 k（200..218）；末厅入口 abe1f4ad@k218 → TileRunner(677,242,33,16,-1) 同刻同哈希 → 出口 4e75665f@**k6660=oracle 完全一致**（TileRunner 转写无罪，含每步 2 发漂移骰）。
2. **+169 定位**：ZN(老人 NewNPC) 出口 k6661（=入口 RandomSeed 一掷，NewNPC 本体 0 骰）→ 169 条 ZW|9（条纹窗墙 PlaceWall）逐条 k+1（6661→6830）→ ZP|10|13（门 PlaceTile）入口 k6830 → 出口 k6833=0.675 mark。**PlaceWall→SquareWallFrame 链每调用恒耗 1 骰**（反编译 PlaceWall 本体无 rand——IL 层行为，探针为准；与 wall==0 写门无关，169 连位无跳变）。

44	  skyTheme?: boolean; // flag12 天空主题箱（style 13 或主件 159/65/158/2219,cs:36227）

51	const DUNGEON_WALLS = new Set([7, 8, 9, 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99]);

56	// ---------- 战利品辅助 ----------
57	/** 原版物品 id → 本仓库物品 id;未注册返回 -1。
58	 *  VANILLA_ITEM_KEY_BY_ID 全量映射（vi_ 表覆盖 6146 件）——旧 vanillaItemKey
59	 *  只认 snake_case 显式注册（少数），宝箱战利品曾整条静默丢失 */
60	function vid(id: number): number {
61	  const k = VANILLA_ITEM_KEY_BY_ID[id];
62	  return k ? (ITEM_BY_KEY[k] ?? -1) : -1;
63	}
64	
65	/** vi_N_… 键反解原版 id;legacy 键返回 null(主件直接用物品 id 入箱) */
66	function vanillaIdOfKey(key: string): number | null {
67	  const m = /^vi_(\d+)_/.exec(key);
68	  return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : null;
69	}

71	/** 锭 id(GenVars.copperBar 等语义:按本世界替代矿档位) */
72	function barIds(gs: GenState): { copper: number; iron: number; silver: number; gold: number } {
73	  const keyOf = (t: number) => TILE_DEFS[t]?.key ?? '';
74	  return {
75	    copper: keyOf(gs.oreTiers.copper).includes('tin') ? 703 : 20,
76	    iron: keyOf(gs.oreTiers.iron).includes('lead') ? 704 : 22,
77	    silver: keyOf(gs.oreTiers.silver).includes('tungsten') ? 705 : 21,
78	    gold: keyOf(gs.oreTiers.gold).includes('platinum') ? 706 : 19,
79	  };
80	}

82	/** 地狱箱主件序：Reset 已按原版位置洗牌（WorldGen.ts vanillaTerrain ④，
83	 *  cs:11262-11274——种子等价要求该洗牌发生在 pass 循环前，此处只轮换取用） */
84	function nextHellItem(gs: GenState): number {
85	  const items = gs.hellChestItems ?? [274, 220, 112, 218, 3019]; // 兜底（探针直调）
86	  return items[gs.hellChestIdx % items.length]; // 自增移到放置成功后（cs:36257-36264）
87	}

89	/** Chest.NearOtherChests（Terraria/Chest.cs:524-538）1:1：[x-25,x+25) × [y-8,y+8)
90	 *  内已有 BasicChest{21,467} → true。本仓"已有箱"按 chest/dresser 键族近似
91	 *  （与 MicroBiomesPass isContainer/TileID.Sets.IsAContainer 同口径，含 467/88） */
92	function nearOtherChests(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
93	  for (let i = x - 25; i < x + 25; i++) {
94	    for (let j = y - 8; j < y + 8; j++) {
95	      if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) continue;   // Framing.GetTileSafely 界外 = 空格
96	      const k = st.idx(i, j);
97	      if (!st.flags[k]) continue;
98	      const key = TILE_DEFS[st.type[k]]?.key ?? '';
99	      if (key.includes('chest') || key.includes('dresser')) return true;
100	    }
101	  }
102	  return false;
103	}

105	/** 常春藤箱主件序(GetNextJungleChestItem cs:10130:循环 211/212/213/964 + 稀有替换) */
106	export function nextJungleItem(gs: GenState, rng: RNG): number {
107	  let result = [211, 212, 213, 964][gs.jungleItemIdx % 4];
108	  if (rng.int(0, 49) === 0) result = 753;       // 1/50 海草
109	  else if (rng.int(0, 14) === 0) result = 2292; // 1/15 玻璃钢鱼竿
110	  else if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) result = 3017; // 1/20 花之靴
111	  gs.jungleItemIdx++;
112	  return result;
113	}

117	/**
118	 * AddBuriedChest 战利品主体(cs:36283-37360)1:1:按深度四分支。
119	 * mainVanillaId>0 → 主题主件(冰箱/沙箱/常春藤/水箱/地狱/金字塔等),
120	 * 否则按分支掷默认主件;各分支再按原版顺序逐项掷概率杂物表。
121	 */
122	export function rollChestLoot(ctx: LootCtx, mainVanillaId: number): Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null> {
123	  const { rng, gs, gy, flags } = ctx;
124	  const bars = barIds(gs);
125	  const out: Array<{ id: number; stack: number }> = [];
126	  const push = (v: number, stack = 1) => {
127	    const id = vid(v);
128	    if (id >= 0 && out.length < 40) out.push({ id, stack });
129	  };
130	  const pick = (arr: number[]) => arr[rng.int(0, arr.length - 1)];
131	
132	  // ---- 分支判定(cs:36283 flag23 / 36563 / 36789 / 37163)----
133	  // 地表分支 = 木箱(style0 flag)/天空箱(style12 flag6)且深度(ws+25) 之外，
134	  // ★flag11（cs:36221：tile21+style≠0+主件∈{848,857,934}）= 金字塔主件箱
135	  //   **无视深度恒走地表/金字塔分支**——曾只按深度判（深层金字塔箱误入金箱分支，
136	  //   掷骰序列整体偏移，金字塔出口隧道相位漂移，dump 对拍实锤）
137	  const isPyrMain = mainVanillaId === 848 || mainVanillaId === 857 || mainVanillaId === 934;
138	  const isSurface = isPyrMain || (gy < gs.worldSurface + 25 && !!(flags.wooden || flags.sky));
139	  const isGold = gy < gs.rockLevel;
140	
141	  if (isSurface) {
142	    // ===== 地表木箱/天空箱(cs:36283-36468)=====
143	    if (mainVanillaId > 0) {
144	      push(mainVanillaId);
145	      if (mainVanillaId === 832) push(933); // cs:36287-36291 世界树主件后插叶法杖
146	      if (mainVanillaId === 848) push(866); // cs:36283-36286 金字塔主件附赠法老袍
147	      if (flags.sky) {
148	        if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) push(5629);
149	        if (rng.int(0, 5) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? 4429 : 4427);
150	        if (rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) push(5528);
151	      }
152	    } else {
153	      push(pick([280, 281, 284, 285, 953, 946, 3068, 3069, 3084, 4341]));
154	    }
155	    if (rng.int(0, 5) === 0) push(282, rng.int(40, 75));   // 1/6 荧光棒
156	    if (rng.int(0, 5) === 0) push(279, rng.int(150, 300)); // 1/6 飞刀
157	    if (rng.int(0, 5) === 0) {                             // 1/6 草药袋(附赠叠层)
158	      let n = 1;
159	      if (rng.int(0, 4) === 0) n += rng.int(0, 1);
160	      if (rng.int(0, 9) === 0) n += rng.int(0, 2);
161	      push(3093, n);
162	    }
163	    if (rng.int(0, 5) === 0) {                             // 1/6 虫罐
164	      let n = 1;
165	      if (rng.int(0, 4) === 0) n += rng.int(0, 1);
166	      if (rng.int(0, 9) === 0) n += rng.int(0, 2);
167	      push(4345, n);
168	    }
169	    if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) push(168, rng.int(3, 5));     // 1/3 手雷
170	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? bars.copper : bars.iron, rng.int(3, 10));
171	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(965, rng.int(50, 100));  // 绳
172	    if (rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? 40 : 42, rng.int(25, 50)); // 木箭/手里剑
173	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(28, rng.int(3, 5));      // 弱效治疗药水
174	    if (rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) push(2350, rng.int(3, 5));    // 回城药水
175	    if (rng.int(0, 2) > 0) push(pick([292, 298, 299, 290, 2322, 2325]), rng.int(1, 2));
176	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? 8 : 31, rng.int(10, 20));  // 火把/瓶子
177	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(72, rng.int(10, 29));    // 银币
178	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(9, rng.int(50, 99));     // 木材
179	  } else if (isGold) {
180	    // ===== 地下金箱(ws+25 ≤ gy < rockLevel,cs:36563-36789)=====
181	    // flag12 派生（cs:36227）：主件 159 气球/65 抓钩/158 瓶中云/2219 星磁铁 或 style13
182	    const flag12 = !!flags.skyTheme || mainVanillaId === 159 || mainVanillaId === 65
183	      || mainVanillaId === 158 || mainVanillaId === 2219;
184	    if (mainVanillaId > 0) {
185	      if (mainVanillaId === 832) push(933); // cs:36549-36553 主件前插叶法杖
186	      push(mainVanillaId);
187	      if (flags.water) {
188	        if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(4425);
189	        if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(4460);
190	      }
191	      if (flag12 && rng.int(0, 39) === 0) push(4978); // cs:36568 1/40 幼翼
192	      // 蘑菇箱 flag7（cs:36689-36702）：1/2 蘑菇矿车；1/3 三件套
193	      if (flags.mushroom) {
194	        if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(4450);
195	        if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) { push(4779); push(4780); push(4781); }
196	      }
197	      // 地牢箱 flag9 门（cs:36597-36611，flag10 上锁箱不给钥匙）：
198	      // 首只暗影钥匙必给（无则 1/3）、Ram Rune 1/8
199	      if (flags.dungeon && !flags.lockedBiome) {
200	        if (!gs.generatedShadowKey || rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
201	          gs.generatedShadowKey = true;
202	          push(329);
203	        }
204	        if (!gs.generatedRamRune || rng.int(0, 7) === 0) {
205	          gs.generatedRamRune = true;
206	          push(5465);
207	        }
208	      }
209	      // ★ivy(3360/3361/4426/5525) 附赠原版只在洞穴分支（cs:36864-36880）——
210	      // 金箱分支无 flag4 段（cs:36545-36703），曾误带致常春藤箱落金箱深度多整套附赠
211	    } else {
212	      push(pick([49, 50, 53, 54, 5011, 975]));
213	      if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) push(997);                    // 1/20 提炼机
214	      else if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) { push(930); push(931, rng.int(25, 50)); } // 1/20 信号枪+闪光弹
215	    }
216	    if (flags.desert) { if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) push(4423, rng.int(10, 19)); }
217	    else if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) push(166, rng.int(10, 19)); // 炸弹
218	    if (rng.int(0, 4) === 0) push(52);                        // 1/5 天使雕像
219	    if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) push(965, rng.int(50, 100));
220	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? bars.iron : bars.silver, rng.int(5, 14));
221	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? 40 : 42, rng.int(25, 49));
222	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(28, rng.int(3, 5));
223	    if (rng.int(0, 2) > 0) push(pick([289, 298, 299, 290, 303, 291, 304, 2322, 2329]), rng.int(1, 2));
224	    if (rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) push(2350, rng.int(2, 4));
225	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(flags.ice ? 974 : 8, rng.int(10, 20)); // 冰火把/火把 cs:36820 Next(11)+10=[10,20]（曾 10,19 漏 20）
226	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(72, rng.int(50, 89));
227	  } else if (gy <= ctx.worldH - 250) {
228	    // ===== 洞穴箱(rockLevel ≤ gy ≤ h-250,cs:36789-37163)=====
229	    // ★门勘误：洞穴/地狱【战利品】分界是 h-250（cs:36839）；h-205 是【样式】门
230	    // （cs:36162 style4）。[h-250,h-205) 带 = 金箱样式 + 地狱战利品（原版如此）——
231	    // 曾误并一道门带出地狱战利品装洞穴箱
232	    if (mainVanillaId > 0) {
233	      push(mainVanillaId);
234	      if (flags.ice && rng.int(0, 4) === 0) push(3199);       // 1/5 冰镜
235	      if (flags.desert) {
236	        if (rng.int(0, 6) === 0) push(4346);                  // 1/7 沙漠矿车
237	        if (rng.int(0, 14) === 0) push(4066);                 // 1/15 沙漠矿车(副)
238	      }
239	      if (flags.ivy) {
240	        if (!gs.gennedMahoganyWands || rng.int(0, 4) === 0) {
241	          gs.gennedMahoganyWands = true;
242	          push(3360); push(3361);
243	        }
244	        if (rng.int(0, 9) === 0) push(4426);
245	        if (rng.int(0, 9) === 0) push(5525);
246	      }
247	      if (flags.water) {
248	        if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(4425);
249	        if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(4460);
250	      }
251	      // 蘑菇箱 flag7（cs:37007-37021：1/2 矿车 否则三件套）
252	      if (flags.mushroom) {
253	        if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(4450);
254	        else { push(4779); push(4780); push(4781); }
255	      }
256	      // 地牢箱 flag9 门（cs:36892-36906，flag10 上锁箱不给钥匙）
257	      if (flags.dungeon && !flags.lockedBiome) {
258	        if (!gs.generatedShadowKey || rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
259	          gs.generatedShadowKey = true;
260	          push(329);
261	        }
262	        if (!gs.generatedRamRune || rng.int(0, 7) === 0) {
263	          gs.generatedRamRune = true;
264	          push(5465);
265	        }
266	      }
267	    } else {
268	      // 主件(cs:36911-36975)：num25=Next(7) 先掷恒消耗（种子对齐），再掷 906/997 门
269	      const num25 = rng.int(0, 6);
270	      if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0 && gy > gs.lavaLine) push(906);
271	      else if (rng.int(0, 14) === 0) push(997);
272	      else {
273	        if (num25 === 6) { push(930); push(931, rng.int(25, 50)); }
274	        else push([49, 50, 53, 54, 5011, 975][num25]);
275	      }
276	    }
277	    if (rng.int(0, 4) === 0) push(flags.ice ? 5120 : 43);     // 1/5(冰箱特殊项/可疑眼球)
278	    if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) push(167);                       // 1/3 炸药
279	    if (rng.int(0, 3) === 0) push(51, rng.int(25, 50));       // 1/4 小丑箭
280	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? bars.gold : bars.silver, rng.int(3, 10));
281	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? 41 : 279, rng.int(25, 50)); // 烈焰箭/飞刀
282	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(188, rng.int(3, 5));        // 治疗药水
283	    if (rng.int(0, 2) > 0) push(pick([296, 295, 299, 302, 303, 305]), rng.int(1, 2));
284	    if (rng.int(0, 2) > 1) push(pick([301, 297, 304, 2329, 2351, 2326]), rng.int(1, 2));
285	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(2350, rng.int(2, 4));
286	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? (flags.ice ? 974 : 8) : 282, rng.int(15, 30)); // 火把/荧光棒
287	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(73, rng.int(1, 2));         // 金币
288	  } else {
289	    // ===== 地狱箱(gy > h-205,cs:37163-37360;与 style 4 同门)=====
290	    if (mainVanillaId > 0) {
291	      push(mainVanillaId);
292	      if (rng.int(0, 4) === 0) push(5010);                    // 1/5 宝藏磁铁
293	      if (rng.int(0, 9) === 0) push(4443);
294	      if (rng.int(0, 9) === 0) push(4737);
295	      if (rng.int(0, 9) === 0) push(4551);

300	    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? 117 : bars.gold, rng.int(15, 29)); // 陨铁锭/金锭

307	    if (rng.int(0, 3) > 0) push(pick([296, 295, 293, 288, 294, 297, 304, 2323]), rng.int(1, 2));

333	    if (f12 && rng.int(0, 2) === 0) push(2197);
334	    if (flags.temple) push(2195); // flag13（cs:37428）：蜥蜴炉恒给
335	    if (flags.dungeon && rng.int(0, 7) === 0) push(2192); // flag9（cs:37432）1/8 血腥砍刀
336	    if (f12) {
337	      const n38 = rng.int(0, 5);
338	      push([5258, 5226, 5254, 5238, 5255, 5388][n38]); // cs:37440-37468
339	      push(751, rng.int(50, 100));
340	    }
341	    // 上锁生物群系箱 1/2 → 5234 虔诚残片（cs:37494-37498）
342	    if (flags.lockedBiome && rng.int(0, 1) === 0) push(5234);
343	    if (flags.temple) { // flag13 尾（cs:37479-37491）：1/5 日耀碑 否则碎片 [3,7]
344	      if (rng.int(0, 4) === 0) push(2767);
345	      else push(2766, rng.int(3, 7));
346	    }
347	    // voice 门（cs:37557）：恒掷 Next(12)；命中 1/12 时 AddVoiceChangeItemToChest
348	    // 内 Item.GetRandomVoiceItem 还要掷 Next(14)——曾漏（命中即短一掷，流漂移）
349	    if (rng.int(0, 11) === 0) rng.int(0, 13);
350	  }
351	  // 键主件(如金字塔/蛛网/世界树的特殊掉落直接给 key)置首。
352	  // 同一原版物品可能有两个注册键:调用方显式键(如 vi_832_living_wood_wand)与
353	  // vid() 的规范驼峰键(items.ts 自动注册循环 vi_832_LivingWoodWand)。mainKey 与
354	  // mainVanillaId 同源(placeBuriedChest 由键反解)时,先剔除 push(mainVanillaId)
355	  // 经 vid() 入箱的那份,再按调用方指定键入箱——否则世界树宝箱会出现两根活木魔棒。
356	  if (ctx.mainKey) {
357	    const keyId = ITEM_BY_KEY[ctx.mainKey];
358	    if (keyId !== undefined) {
359	      if (vanillaIdOfKey(ctx.mainKey) !== null && vanillaIdOfKey(ctx.mainKey) === mainVanillaId) {
360	        const viaVid = vid(mainVanillaId);
361	        const idx = items.findIndex((it) => it && it.id === viaVid);
362	        if (idx >= 0) items.splice(idx, 1);
363	      }
364	      if (!items.some((it) => it && it.id === keyId)) items.unshift({ id: keyId, stack: 1 });
365	    }
366	  }
367	  return items;
368	}

370	/** AddBuriedChest（1456 cs:35920）下落/门禁段 1:1：
371	 *  自 j 向下扫至 k < maxTilesY-10，逐行检查 anyShimmer / 幼虫 231 → 整体失败；
372	 *  首个 SolidTile（半砖/坡面不算，WorldGen.SolidTile）落定。
373	 *  ±2 邻域（InWorld 100 边距）有 Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716}/祭坛 26/蜥蜴祭坛 237 → 失败
374	 *  ——该检查在扫描循环内**逐行**执行（锚=当前行 k，cs:35992-36002），非仅起始行。
375	 *  notNearOtherChests:true 时经 Chest.NearOtherChests（±25×±8 已有箱）拒绝（cs:36253 透传）。
376	 *  样式/战利品解析与 2×2 放置沿用本仓库 rollChestLoot 管线。 */
377	export function placeBuriedChest(
378	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink,
379	  i: number, j: number, opts: { style?: number; tile?: number; loot?: number | string; flags?: ChestFlags; trySlope?: boolean; notNearOtherChests?: boolean } = {},
380	): boolean {
381	  // 下落到地面（cs:35931 `for k=j; k<maxTilesY-10; k++`）
382	  let gy = j;
383	  let slopeL = -1, slopeR = -1;   // trySlope 压平的坡度（失败时回填，cs:37567-37575）
384	  for (; gy < st.h - 10; gy++) {
385	    const k = st.idx(i, gy);
386	    if (st.liquid[k] > 0 && st.liquidType[k] === 4) return false;              // anyShimmer → 整体失败
387	    if (st.flags[k] && st.type[k] === LARVA) return false;                      // 幼虫 231 → 整体失败
388	    // ★±2 巨石/祭坛拒绝在扫描循环内**逐行**执行（cs:35992-36002，锚=当前行 k：
389	    //   InWorld(n,num6,100) && Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716} || 26 || 237）。
390	    //   曾在进循环前以起始行 j 只查一次——起始行下方 2 格内的滚石/祭坛全部漏检
391	    for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
392	      for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
393	        const xx = i + dx, yy = gy + dy;
394	        if (xx < 100 || yy < 100 || xx >= st.w - 100 || yy >= st.h - 100) continue;
395	        const kk = st.idx(xx, yy);
396	        if (!st.flags[kk]) continue;
397	        const tt = st.type[kk];
398	        if (BOULDER_TILES.has(tt) || tt === ALTAR || tt === TALTAR) return false;
399	      }
400	    }
401	    if (solidTileHB(st, i, gy)) {
402	      // trySlope 门（cs:35951-35968）：style 17 时 ±30 盒内不得有箱/越界；
403	      // 压平 (i-1,gy)/(i,gy) 的顶坡供放置（失败时回填）
404	      if (opts.trySlope && opts.style === 17) {
405	        for (let l = i - 30; l <= i + 30; l++) {
406	          for (let m = gy - 30; m <= gy + 30; m++) {
407	            if (l < 5 || m < 5 || l >= st.w - 5 || m >= st.h - 5) return false;  // InWorld(l,m,5)
408	            const nk = st.idx(l, m);
409	            if (st.flags[nk] && (st.type[nk] === CHEST || st.type[nk] === CHEST2)) return false;
410	          }
411	        }
412	      }
413	      if (opts.trySlope) {
414	        if (st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] >= 1 && st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] <= 2) {
415	          slopeL = st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)];
416	          st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] = 0;
417	        }
418	        if (st.slope[k] >= 1 && st.slope[k] <= 2) {
419	          slopeR = st.slope[k];
420	          st.slope[k] = 0;
421	        }
422	      }
423	      break;
424	    }
425	  }
426	  if (gy >= st.h - 10) return false;
427	  if (!solidTileHB(st, i, gy)) return false;
428	  // trySlope 失败回填（cs:37567-37575：仅压平过的格才恢复）
429	  const restoreSlopes = (): void => {
430	    if (slopeL > -1) st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] = slopeL;
431	    if (slopeR > -1) st.slope[st.idx(i, gy)] = slopeR;
432	  };
433	
434	  let tile = opts.tile ?? CHEST;
435	  let style = opts.style;
436	  const flags: ChestFlags = { ...(opts.flags ?? {}) };
437	  let mainId = 0;
438	  let mainKey: string | null = null;
439	  if (typeof opts.loot === 'string') {
440	    mainKey = opts.loot;
441	    mainId = vanillaIdOfKey(opts.loot) ?? 0;
442	    if (mainId === 0 && ITEM_BY_KEY[opts.loot] === undefined) mainKey = null; // 无效键丢弃
443	  } else if (opts.loot !== undefined) {
444	    mainId = opts.loot;
445	  }
446	  if (style === undefined) {
447	    if (gy > st.h - 205) {
448	      // 地狱箱:style 4 + 地狱武器序(cs:36158-36171)
449	      style = 4;
450	      flags.hell = true;
451	      if (!mainId) mainId = nextHellItem(gs);
452	    } else {
453	      style = gy >= gs.worldSurface + 25 ? 1 : 0;
454	      if (style === 0) flags.wooden = true;
455	    }
456	  }
457	  // ---- 冰箱门（cs:36107-36130 1:1）：三析取——(tile21&&style11) ||
458	  // (tile467&&style24) || (无主件 && 位置 && 脚下冰系)。★原版显式传 style 11
459	  // 也进本池（HouseBuilder 冰屋正是此路径）——旧实现 style===undefined 单门漏此
460	  const tBelow = st.type[st.idx(i, gy)];
461	  if ((tile === CHEST && style === 11) || (tile === CHEST2 && style === 24)
462	    || (!mainId && gy >= gs.worldSurface + 25 && gy <= st.h - 205
463	      && (tBelow === SNOW || tBelow === ICE || tBelow === THIN_ICE))) {
464	    flags.ice = true;
465	    if (!mainId) {
466	      mainId = [670, 724, 950, 1319, 987, 1579][rng.int(0, 5)]; // cs:36121-36125
467	      if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) mainId = 997; // 1/20 提炼机
468	      if (rng.int(0, 49) === 0) mainId = 669; // 1/50 鱼
469	    }
470	  }
471	  // ---- 沙漠箱门（cs:36066-36091 1:1）：三析取——(tile467&&style10) ||
472	  // (tile21&&style42&&flag16) || (无主件 && ≤h-205 && IsUndergroundDesert)
473	  const ud = gs.undergroundDesert;
474	  const inUd = !mainId && ud && i >= ud.x0 && i <= ud.x1 && gy >= ud.y0 && gy <= ud.y1 && gy <= st.h - 205;
475	  if ((tile === CHEST2 && style === 10) || inUd) {
476	    tile = CHEST2;
477	    style = 10;
478	    flags.desert = true;
479	    // cs:36084：分位点用蜂巢**实际雕刻范围**（desertHiveHigh/Low，PlaceClustersArea
480	    // 逐点收缩），非静态矩形 ±10（曾用 ud.y0/y1 → 分层界偏移）
481	    const deep = gy > (gs.desertHiveHigh * 3 + gs.desertHiveLow * 4) / 7;
482	    if (!mainId) {
483	      mainId = deep
484	        ? [4061, 4062, 4276][rng.int(0, 2)]
485	        : [4056, 4055, 4262, 4263][rng.int(0, 3)];
486	    }
487	  }
488	
489	  // ---- notNearOtherChests 通道（cs:36253 透传 → PlaceChest cs:57838-57840）：
490	  // 原版 `notNearOtherChests && Chest.NearOtherChests(x-1, y-1)` → 拒。PlaceChest 收到
491	  // (i-1, num7-1)（num7=落定行 gy），故 NearOtherChests 实扫锚 = (i-2, gy-2)。
492	  // 本仓消费点：蜘蛛巢/神庙宝箱应传 true（HiveSpiderPass/TemplePass 两处调用点
493	  // 由并行代理接线，此处先开通道；缺省 false = 与原版 notNearOtherChests:false 同义）
494	  if (opts.notNearOtherChests && nearOtherChests(st, i - 2, gy - 2)) { restoreSlopes(); return false; }
495	
496	  // 2×2 放置（PlaceChest → TileObject.CanPlace 语义，cs:57828/:174）：
497	  // AddBuriedChest 调 PlaceChest(i-1, num7-1)，chest TileObjectData Origin=(0,1)、
498	  // Width=2 → 箱体落 **(i-1..i)×(gy-2..gy-1)**、锚腿 (i-1)/i 行 gy——曾写在
499	  // (i..i+1) = 整体右移一列（金字塔箱 dump 对拍实锤；所有宝箱调用点共用此偏移）
500	  const topY = gy - 2;
501	  if (topY < 1) { restoreSlopes(); return false; }
502	  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 0; dx++) {
503	    for (let dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) {
504	      if (!st.inBounds(i + dx, topY + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(i + dx, topY + dy)]) { restoreSlopes(); return false; }
505	    }
506	  }
507	  // 样式派生 flag 族（cs:36201-36229）：32 蘑菇 / 16 神庙 / 13 天空主题
508	  if (style === 32) flags.mushroom = true;
509	  if (style === 16) flags.temple = true;
510	  if (style === 13) flags.skyTheme = true;
511	  // 锚腿落地判定（CanPlace AnchorBottom 两列 = i-1/i；k 扫描列 i 已验 SolidTile）：
512	  // solid 走 GenSolid（本 pass 时点 484 滚动仙人掌/659 以太石块等已被翻非实心，
513	  // WorldGen.cs:12537/11500——原版 PlaceChest 读可变 tileSolid 同样不认它们为地面）
514	  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 0; dx++) {
515	    if (!st.inBounds(i + dx, gy) || !st.flags[st.idx(i + dx, gy)]
516	      || !genSolidType(st.type[st.idx(i + dx, gy)])) { restoreSlopes(); return false; }
517	  }
518	  const fw = TILE_DEFS[tile].vanilla?.fw ?? 2;
519	  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 0; dx++) {
520	    for (let dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) {
521	      st.setTileSilent(i + dx, topY + dy, tile, style * fw * 18 + (dx + 1) * 18, dy * 18);
522	    }
523	  }
524	  // 战利品:四深度分支完整表(此前仅主件+火把/药水,体感稀缺主因之一)
525	  const items = rollChestLoot({ rng, gs, gy, flags, mainKey, worldH: st.h }, mainId);
526	  chests.push({ x: i - 1, y: topY, items });   // Chest.CreateChest(xCoord,yCoord)=(i-1,gy-2)
527	  if (flags.hell) gs.hellChestIdx++; // cs:36257-36264 放置成功才前进（失败重试取同一件）
528	  return true;
529	}

531	/** Buried Chests pass:L7907 洞穴段(CaveChestCount 35-40 × WorldArea/5040000)。
532	 *  ★地狱段拆出 runUnderworldChestsPass:本函数曾在 hellPass 之前执行,
533	 *  地狱箱被后续地狱地形重写 100% 抹除(实际 0 个) */
534	export function runBuriedChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
535	  const { w, h } = st;
536	  const yMin = Math.floor((gs.worldSurfaceHigh + 20 + gs.rockLevel) / 2);
537	  // 洞穴箱:35-40 × 面积缩放(Configuration.json CaveChestCount ScaleWith:WorldArea)。
538	  // ★WorldGenRange.GetRandom(WorldGenRange.cs:34-57):先缩放边界再 (int) 截断 →
539	  //   Next((int)(35s), (int)(40s)+1)。曾"先掷后乘+Math.round"(C10 同款旧公式)
540	  const target = gs.caveChestCount >= 0 ? gs.caveChestCount
541	    : rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * (w * h) / 5040000), Math.trunc(40 * (w * h) / 5040000));
542	  let fail = 10000;
543	  for (let n = 0; n < target && fail > 0; ) {
544	    const x = rng.int(20, w - 21);
545	    const y = rng.int(yMin, h - 231);
546	    const wl = st.inBounds(x, y) ? st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] : -1;
547	    // cs:17109：wallDungeon[wall] || wall == 87（神庙墙 87 独立门）→ 整体重掷
548	    if (isDungeonWall(wl) || wl === 87 || !placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y)) {
549	      fail--; continue;
550	    }
551	    n++;
552	  }
553	}
554	
555	/** 地狱箱(UnderworldChestCount 10-15 × WorldWidth/4200)。
556	 *  必须在 hellPass + 地狱屋之后调用(原版 Underworld(cs:13697) < Buried Chests(cs:17066)) */
557	export function runUnderworldChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
558	  const { w, h } = st;
559	  // gs 预掷优先(cs:17082 流位);回退公式同步 WorldGenRange 化(先缩放后截,
560	  // 曾 Math.round(rng.int(10,15)*(w/4200)) 旧式)
561	  const target = gs.underworldChestCount >= 0 ? gs.underworldChestCount
562	    : rng.int(Math.trunc(10 * (w / 4200)), Math.trunc(15 * (w / 4200)));
563	  let fail = 10000;
564	  for (let n = 0; n < target && fail > 0; ) {
565	    const x = rng.int(20, w - 21);
566	    const y = rng.int(h - 200, h - 51);
567	    if (!placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y)) {
568	      fail--; continue;
569	    }
570	    n++;
571	  }
572	}
573	
574	/** Surface Chests pass(L8019):w*0.005 个地表木箱(style 0;墙 244 → 天空箱 style 12) */
575	export function runSurfaceChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
576	  const { w } = st;
577	  const count = Math.floor(w * 0.005);
578	  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
579	    let ok = false;
580	    for (let tries = 0; tries < 2000 && !ok; tries++) {
581	      // cs:17244 首掷 Next(200, w-200);仅落点命中 oceanDepths(cs:17246-17254:
582	      // y ≤ oceanLevel=(ws+rl)/2+40 且 x 在海滩带内)才改掷 Next(300, w-300)——
583	      // 原版 WorldGen.beachDistance 是常量 380(cs:4102)
584	      let x = rng.int(200, w - 201);
585	      let y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurfaceLow), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) - 1);
586	      const oceanLevel = (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40;
587	      while (y <= oceanLevel && (x < gs.beachDistance || x > w - gs.beachDistance)) {
588	        x = rng.int(300, w - 301);
589	        y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurfaceLow), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) - 1);
590	      }
591	      if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
592	      const i = st.idx(x, y);
593	      // cs:17260-17284 两分支：空格走墙门（2/59/244，墙 244 → 天空箱）；
594	      // 落点活性格走 101×101（步 2）蓄水池采样找墙 244 空格（Next(num8) 命中即换点）
595	      let sky = false;
596	      let cx = x, cy = y;
597	      if (!st.flags[i]) {
598	        if (st.wall[i] === 2 || st.wall[i] === 59 || st.wall[i] === 244) {
599	          if (st.wall[i] === 244) sky = true;
600	        } else {
601	          continue;   // flag3=false → 本轮作废
602	        }
603	      } else {
604	        let num8 = 1;
605	        let hit = false;
606	        for (let j = cx - 50; j <= cx + 50; j += 2) {
607	          for (let k = cy - 50; k <= cy + 50; k += 2) {
608	            if (k >= gs.worldSurface) continue;
609	            if (!st.inBounds(j, k) || st.flags[st.idx(j, k)]) continue;
610	            if (st.wall[st.idx(j, k)] !== 244) continue;
611	            if (rng.int(0, num8 - 1) !== 0) continue;                    // Next(num8)==0
612	            sky = true;
613	            num8++;
614	            hit = true;
615	            cx = j; cy = k;
616	          }
617	        }
618	        if (!hit) continue;   // 蓄水池无墙 244 空格 → 本轮作废
619	      }
620	      const flags: ChestFlags = sky ? { sky: true } : { wooden: true };
621	      if (placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, cx, cy, { style: sky ? 12 : 0, flags })) ok = true;
622	    }
623	  }
624	}
625	
626	/** UnderwaterChests 的 9×w/4200 段（cs:17381-17453）：每下标两趟 while 各 1 箱——
627	 *  ① y∈[1, UnderworldLayer)（内层液体重掷域 [50, UnderworldLayer)）
628	 *  ② y∈[worldSurface, UnderworldLayer)。主件序：单次 Next(10)==0 → 863，
629	 *  否则计数器 186→4404→277→187（num4 每迭代无条件 ++，命中 863 也前进）。 */
630	export function runWaterChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
631	  const { w } = st;
632	  const num5 = w / 4200;
633	  const count = 9 * num5;
634	  let num4 = 0;
635	  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
636	    num4++;
637	    let main: number;
638	    if (rng.int(0, 9) === 0) {                                          // Next(10)
639	      main = 863;
640	    } else {
641	      switch (num4) {
642	        case 1: main = 186; break;
643	        case 2: main = 4404; break;
644	        case 3: main = 277; break;
645	        default: main = 187; num4 = 0; break;
646	      }
647	    }
648	    // 第一趟（cs:17424-17431）：y 首掷 [1, h-200)，重掷 [50, h-200)
649	    for (let loop = 0; loop < 2; loop++) {
650	      const yLo = loop === 0 ? 1 : Math.floor(gs.worldSurface);
651	      let ok = false;
652	      for (let tries = 0; tries < 10000 && !ok; tries++) {
653	        let x = rng.int(50, w - 51);                                    // Next(50, w-50)
654	        let y = rng.int(yLo, st.h - 201);                               // Next(?, h-200)
655	        // cs:17425-17428：液体不足或非水 → 重掷（重掷 y 域换 [50, h-200)）。
656	        // liquidType 修 2026-08-12：本仓库 +1 编码(水=LIQUID_TYPE.WATER=1)——照抄原版
657	        // !==0(原版 Water=0) 会让水格恒不命中,拒绝采样死循环(世界生成卡"生物群系"根因)。
658	        // 守卫:100 万掷未命中 → 大声报错降级继续(防同类移植错位再变静默死循环)
659	        let __guard = 0;
660	        while (st.liquid[st.idx(x, y)] < 250 || st.liquidType[st.idx(x, y)] !== LIQUID_TYPE.WATER) {
661	          x = rng.int(50, w - 51);

	private static List<Rectangle> CreateRooms(Point origin)
	{
		if (WorldGen.SecretSeed.GenerateBiggerAbandonedHouses)
		{
			return CreateRooms_BigAbandonedHouses(origin);
		}
		if (!WorldUtils.Find(origin, Searches.Chain(new Searches.Down(200), new Conditions.IsSolid()), out var result) || result == origin)
		{
			return new List<Rectangle>();
		}
		Rectangle item = FindRoom(result);
		Rectangle rectangle = FindRoom(new Point(item.Center.X, item.Y + 1));
		Rectangle rectangle2 = FindRoom(new Point(item.Center.X, item.Y + item.Height + 10));
		rectangle2.Y = item.Y + item.Height - 1;
		double roomSolidPrecentage = GetRoomSolidPrecentage(rectangle);
		double roomSolidPrecentage2 = GetRoomSolidPrecentage(rectangle2);
		item.Y += 3;
		rectangle.Y += 3;
		rectangle2.Y += 3;
		List<Rectangle> list = new List<Rectangle>();
		if (WorldGen.genRand.NextDouble() > roomSolidPrecentage + 0.2)
		{
			list.Add(rectangle);
		}
		list.Add(item);
		if (WorldGen.genRand.NextDouble() > roomSolidPrecentage2 + 0.2)
		{
			list.Add(rectangle2);
		}
		return list;
	}

	private static Rectangle FindRoom(Point origin)
	{
		Point result;
		bool flag = WorldUtils.Find(origin, Searches.Chain(new Searches.Left(25), new Conditions.IsSolid()), out result);
		Point result2;
		bool num = WorldUtils.Find(origin, Searches.Chain(new Searches.Right(25), new Conditions.IsSolid()), out result2);
		if (!flag)
		{
			result = new Point(origin.X - 25, origin.Y);
		}
		if (!num)
		{
			result2 = new Point(origin.X + 25, origin.Y);
		}
		Rectangle result3 = new Rectangle(origin.X, origin.Y, 0, 0);
		if (origin.X - result.X > result2.X - origin.X)
		{
			result3.X = result.X;
			result3.Width = Utils.Clamp(result2.X - result.X, 15, 30);
		}
		else
		{
			result3.Width = Utils.Clamp(result2.X - result.X, 15, 30);
			result3.X = result2.X - result3.Width;
		}
		Point result4;
		bool flag2 = WorldUtils.Find(result, Searches.Chain(new Searches.Up(10), new Conditions.IsSolid()), out result4);
		Point result5;
		bool num2 = WorldUtils.Find(result2, Searches.Chain(new Searches.Up(10), new Conditions.IsSolid()), out result5);
		if (!flag2)
		{
			result4 = new Point(origin.X, origin.Y - 10);
		}
		if (!num2)
		{
			result5 = new Point(origin.X, origin.Y - 10);
		}
		result3.Height = Utils.Clamp(Math.Max(origin.Y - result4.Y, origin.Y - result5.Y), 8, 12);
		result3.Y -= result3.Height;
		return result3;
	}

	private static Rectangle FindRoom_BigAbandonedHouses(Point origin, Rectangle lastRoom)
	{
		int minValue = 15;
		int num = 30;
		int minValue2 = 8;
		int num2 = 12;
		Point result;
		bool flag = WorldUtils.Find(origin, Searches.Chain(new Searches.Left(25), new Conditions.IsSolid()), out result);
		Point result2;
		bool num3 = WorldUtils.Find(origin, Searches.Chain(new Searches.Right(25), new Conditions.IsSolid()), out result2);
		if (!flag)
		{
			result = new Point(origin.X - 25, origin.Y);
		}
		if (!num3)
		{
			result2 = new Point(origin.X + 25, origin.Y);
		}
		Rectangle result3 = new Rectangle(origin.X, origin.Y, 0, 0);
		if (WorldGen.genRand.Next(2) == 0)
		{
			if (result.X < lastRoom.Left)
			{
				result.X = lastRoom.Left;
			}
			result3.X = result.X;
			result3.Width = WorldGen.genRand.Next(minValue, num + 1);
			if (result3.Left <= 10)
			{
				result3.X = 10;
			}
			if (result3.Right >= Main.maxTilesX - 10)
			{
				result3.X = Main.maxTilesX - 10 - result3.Width;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			if (result2.X > lastRoom.Right)
			{
				result2.X = lastRoom.Right;
			}
			result3.Width = WorldGen.genRand.Next(minValue, num + 1);
			result3.X = result2.X - result3.Width;
			if (result3.Left <= 10)
			{
				result3.X = 10;
			}
			if (result3.Right >= Main.maxTilesX - 10)
			{
				result3.X = Main.maxTilesX - 10 - result3.Width;
			}
		}
		result3.Height = WorldGen.genRand.Next(minValue2, num2 + 1);
		result3.Y -= result3.Height;
		return result3;
	}

	private static double GetRoomSolidPrecentage(Rectangle room)
	{
		double num = room.Width * room.Height;
		Ref<int> obj = new Ref<int>(0);
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(room.X, room.Y), new Shapes.Rectangle(room.Width, room.Height), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.Count(obj)));
		return (double)obj.Value / num;
	}

	private static bool AreRoomLocationsValid(IEnumerable<Rectangle> rooms)
	{
		foreach (Rectangle room in rooms)
		{
			if (!WorldGen.InWorld(room, 10))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (room.Y + room.Height > Main.maxTilesY - 220)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private static HouseType GetHouseType(IEnumerable<Rectangle> rooms)
	{
		Dictionary<ushort, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<ushort, int>();
		foreach (Rectangle room in rooms)
		{
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(room.X - 10, room.Y - 10), new Shapes.Rectangle(room.Width + 20, room.Height + 20), new Actions.TileScanner(0, 59, 147, 1, 161, 53, 396, 397, 368, 367, 60, 70).Output(dictionary));
		}

			Tuple.Create(HouseType.Jungle, dictionary[59] + dictionary[60] * 10),
			Tuple.Create(HouseType.Mushroom, dictionary[59] + dictionary[70] * 10),
			Tuple.Create(HouseType.Ice, dictionary[147] + dictionary[161]),
			Tuple.Create(HouseType.Desert, dictionary[397] + dictionary[396] + dictionary[53]),
			Tuple.Create(HouseType.Granite, dictionary[368]),
			Tuple.Create(HouseType.Marble, dictionary[367])
		};
		Tuple<HouseType, int> tuple = list[0];
		for (int i = 1; i < list.Count; i++)
		{
			if (tuple.Item2 < list[i].Item2)
			{
				tuple = list[i];
			}
		}
		return tuple.Item1;
	}

	private static bool AreRoomsValid(IEnumerable<Rectangle> rooms, StructureMap structures, HouseType style)
	{
		foreach (Rectangle room in rooms)
		{
			if (style != HouseType.Granite && WorldUtils.Find(new Point(room.X - 2, room.Y - 2), Searches.Chain(new Searches.Rectangle(room.Width + 4, room.Height + 4).RequireAll(mode: false), new Conditions.HasLava()), out var _))

			{
				return false;

		return true;
	}

	public virtual void Place(HouseBuilderContext context, StructureMap structures)
	{
		PlaceEmptyRooms();
		foreach (Rectangle room in Rooms)
		{
			structures.AddProtectedStructure(room, 8);
		}
		PlaceStairs();
		PlaceDoors();
		PlacePlatforms();
		PlaceSupportBeams();
		PlaceBiomeSpecificPriorityTool(context);
		FillRooms();
		foreach (Rectangle room2 in Rooms)
		{
			AgeRoom(room2);
		}
		PlaceChests();
		PlaceBiomeSpecificTool(context);
		PaintSeedHouses();
	}

	private void PlaceEmptyRooms()
	{
		foreach (Rectangle room in Rooms)
		{
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(room.X, room.Y), new Shapes.Rectangle(room.Width, room.Height), Actions.Chain(new Actions.SetTileKeepWall(TileType), new Actions.SetFrames(frameNeighbors: true)));
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(room.X + 1, room.Y + 1), new Shapes.Rectangle(room.Width - 2, room.Height - 2), Actions.Chain(new Actions.ClearTile(frameNeighbors: true), new Actions.PlaceWall(WallType)));
		}

	private void PlaceStairs()

			{

			}
			WorldUtils.Gen(item, new ModShapes.All(shapeData), Actions.Chain(new Actions.PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle), new Actions.SetSlope((num == 1) ? 1 : 2), new Actions.SetFrames(frameNeighbors: true)));
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(item.X + ((num == 1) ? 1 : (-4)), item.Y - 1), new Shapes.Rectangle(4, 1), Actions.Chain(new Actions.Clear(), new Actions.PlaceWall(WallType), new Actions.PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle), new Actions.SetFrames(frameNeighbors: true)));

	private List<Tuple<Point, Point>> CreateStairsList()
	{
		List<Tuple<Point, Point>> list = new List<Tuple<Point, Point>>();
		for (int i = 1; i < Rooms.Count; i++)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = Rooms[i];
			Rectangle rectangle2 = Rooms[i - 1];
			int num = rectangle2.X - rectangle.X;
			int num2 = rectangle.X + rectangle.Width - (rectangle2.X + rectangle2.Width);
			if (num > num2)
			{
				list.Add(new Tuple<Point, Point>(new Point(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width - 1, rectangle.Y + 1), new Point(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width - rectangle.Height + 1, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height - 1)));
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(new Tuple<Point, Point>(new Point(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y + 1), new Point(rectangle.X + rectangle.Height - 1, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height - 1)));
			}
		}
		return list;
	}

	private void PlaceDoors()
	{
		foreach (Point item in CreateDoorList())
		{
			WorldUtils.Gen(item, new Shapes.Rectangle(1, 3), new Actions.ClearTile(frameNeighbors: true));
			WorldGen.PlaceTile(item.X, item.Y, 10, mute: true, forced: true, -1, DoorStyle);
		}
	}

	private List<Point> CreateDoorList()
	{
		List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
		foreach (Rectangle room in Rooms)
		{
			if (FindSideExit(new Rectangle(room.X + room.Width, room.Y + 1, 1, room.Height - 2), isLeft: false, out var exitY))
			{
				list.Add(new Point(room.X + room.Width - 1, exitY));
			}
			if (FindSideExit(new Rectangle(room.X, room.Y + 1, 1, room.Height - 2), isLeft: true, out exitY))
			{
				list.Add(new Point(room.X, exitY));
			}
		}
		return list;
	}

	private void PlacePlatforms()
	{
		foreach (Point item in CreatePlatformsList())
		{
			WorldUtils.Gen(item, new Shapes.Rectangle(3, 1), Actions.Chain(new Actions.ClearMetadata(), new Actions.PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle), new Actions.SetFrames(frameNeighbors: true)));
		}
	}

	private List<Point> CreatePlatformsList()
	{
		List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
		Rectangle topRoom = TopRoom;
		Rectangle bottomRoom = BottomRoom;
		if (FindVerticalExit(new Rectangle(topRoom.X + 2, topRoom.Y, topRoom.Width - 4, 1), isUp: true, out var exitX))
		{
			list.Add(new Point(exitX, topRoom.Y));
		}
		if (FindVerticalExit(new Rectangle(bottomRoom.X + 2, bottomRoom.Y + bottomRoom.Height - 1, bottomRoom.Width - 4, 1), isUp: false, out exitX))
		{
			list.Add(new Point(exitX, bottomRoom.Y + bottomRoom.Height - 1));
		}
		return list;
	}

				Tile tile = _tiles[item.X, item.Y + item.Height];
				tile.slope(0);
				tile.halfBrick(halfBrick: false);
			}
		}
	}

export function solidTile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {

// 位级移植要点（JS/C# 数值差异全部钉死，改动前先读）：
//  1. C# int 溢出 unchecked 回绕 ↔ JS：本实现所有中间值都落在 int32 范围内
//     （diff 最小 -(2^31-1)，`+((n>>31)&0x7FFFFFFF)` 归位后 ∈[0,2^31-1]），
//     无需模拟回绕；存储用 Int32Array 与 C# int[] 同构。
//  2. `(int)double` 是向零截断 ↔ JS Math.trunc（Sample()≥0 时与 floor 等价，
//     但必须写 trunc 以防有人把 internalSample 改出负值）。
//  3. `Sample()` 常数 4.656612875245797E-10 = 1/(2^31-1)，十进制字面量两语言
//     解析为同一 double，乘法 IEEE754 位级一致。
//  4. `Next(min,max)` 的 range 用 long（≤2^32）↔ JS number 精确整数，安全。
//     大 range 分支的 `(int)(long+min)` unchecked 回绕 ↔ JS `|0`（ToInt32 mod 2^32）。
//  5. `GetSampleForLargeRange` 的 `% 2 == 0`：C# 余数带符号但只判零，JS `%` 同判。

// ReLogic.Utilities.Crc32.Calculate（IEEE 表，按 UTF-16 code unit 逐字符，
// 注意 `(crc ^ c) & 0xFF` 只取 char 低字节）。Crc32 结果可为负，直接作种子。
export class UnifiedRandom {
  private seedArray: Int32Array;
  private inext = 0;

  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.seedArray = new Int32Array(56);

    const num = seed === -2147483648 ? 2147483647 : Math.abs(seed);
    let num2 = 161803398 - num;
    this.seedArray[55] = num2;
    let num3 = 1;
    for (let j = 1; j < 55; j++) {
      const num4 = (21 * j) % 55;
      this.seedArray[num4] = num3;
      num3 = (num2 - num3) | 0; // C# unchecked int：可能回绕，|0 = ToInt32 同语义
      if (num3 < 0) num3 += 2147483647; // C# += int.MaxValue（不是 2^32！）
      num2 = this.seedArray[num4];
    }
    for (let k = 1; k < 5; k++) {
      for (let l = 1; l < 56; l++) {
        this.seedArray[l] -= this.seedArray[1 + ((l + 30) % 55)];
        if (this.seedArray[l] < 0) this.seedArray[l] += 2147483647;
      }
    }
    this.inext = 0;
  }

  private sample(): number {

        public static void Tail(GenPass pass)
        {
            try
            {
                Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
                int W = Terraria.Main.maxTilesX, H = Terraria.Main.maxTilesY;
                Terraria.Tile[,] tile = Terraria.Main.tile;
                uint hT = 2166136261u, hA = 2166136261u, hW = 2166136261u, hL = 2166136261u, hG = 2166136261u;
                int n = 0;
                for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
                {
                    int rowBase = y * W;
                    for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)
                    {
                        Terraria.Tile t = tile[x, y];
                        bool act = t.active();
                        ushort typ = act ? t.type : (ushort)0;
                        uint lo = (uint)(typ & 0xFF);
                        uint hi = (uint)(typ >> 8);
                        hT = (hT ^ lo) * 16777619u;
                        hT = (hT ^ hi) * 16777619u;
                        byte a = act ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                        hA = (hA ^ a) * 16777619u;
                        hA = hA * 16777619u;
                        ushort wv = t.wall;
                        lo = (uint)(wv & 0xFF);
                        hi = (uint)(wv >> 8);
                        hW = (hW ^ lo) * 16777619u;
                        hW = (hW ^ hi) * 16777619u;
                        byte l = t.liquid;
                        hL = (hL ^ l) * 16777619u;
                        hL = hL * 16777619u;
                        ushort gho = act ? (ushort)0 : t.type;
                        lo = (uint)(gho & 0xFF);
                        hi = (uint)(gho >> 8);
                        hG = (hG ^ lo) * 16777619u;
                        hG = (hG ^ hi) * 16777619u;
                        n++;
                    }
                }
                sw.Stop();
                _totalMs += sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                DumpGrids(pass.Name, W, H, tile);
                string line = "P|" + (_idx++) + "|" + pass.Name + "|" +
                    Hex(hT) + " " + Hex(hA) + " " + Hex(hW) + " " + Hex(hL) + "|" +
                    Hex(hG) + "|" + StreamHash() + "|" +
                    Terraria.WorldGen.WorldGenParam_Evil + "," + (Terraria.WorldGen.crimson ? 1 : 0) + "|" +
                    sw.ElapsedMilliseconds + "ms/" + _totalMs + "ms|n=" + n;
                if (!_header)
                {
                    _header = true;
                    string head = "#passchain";
                    try
                    {
                        head += " seed=" + Terraria.Main.ActiveWorldFileData.Seed +
                                " seedText=" + Terraria.Main.ActiveWorldFileData.SeedText +
                                " W=" + Terraria.Main.maxTilesX + " H=" + Terraria.Main.maxTilesY;
                    }
                    catch { }
                    File.AppendAllText(DumpPath(), head + "\n");
                }
                File.AppendAllText(DumpPath(), line + "\n");
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Mark("#tail-ex " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message + "\n" + e.StackTrace);
            }
        }

        private static string Hex(uint v)
        {
            return v.ToString("x8");
        }

        // SW_GRID_DUMP="PassName:/pfx[,PassName2:/pfx2]"：pass 名命中时落
        // typ(LE16)/act/wal(LE16)/liq 裸数组（i=y*W+x 序，与 caves-oracle GRID_DUMP 同格式；
        // typ 为 RAW——保留 inactive 格残留 type（幽灵），与 oracle 一致）
        // SW_DUMP_ALL=<dir>：每个 pass 都落 <dir>/<idx>_<名>.{typ,act,wal,liq}
        private static string StreamHash()
        {
            try
            {
                object r = Terraria.Main.rand;
                if (r == null) return "norand";
                if (_fiSeedArray == null)
                {
                    Type t = r.GetType();
                    _fiSeedArray = t.GetField("SeedArray", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
                    _fiInext = t.GetField("inext", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
                }
                int[] sa = (int[])_fiSeedArray.GetValue(r);
                uint ix = (uint)_fiInext.GetValue(r);
                uint h = 2166136261u;
                for (int k = 0; k < sa.Length; k++)
                {
                    int v = sa[k];
                    h = (h ^ (uint)((v) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                    h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                    h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                    h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                }
                h = (h ^ (ix & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                return Hex(h);
            }
            catch (Exception e) { return "ex:" + e.GetType().Name; }
        }

        private static void Mark(string s)
        {
            try { File.AppendAllText("/tmp/sw-num4/home/passchain_err.txt", s + "\n"); } catch { }
        }
    }

  /** C# InternalSample（:67-86）1:1。inext 为 uint 语义（0..55，无溢出面）*/
  private internalSample(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    let num3 = this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
    if (num3 === 2147483647) num3--;
    num3 = num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7fffffff); // >>31 算术移位，JS/C# 一致
    this.seedArray[num] = num3;
    this.inext = num;
    return num3;
  }

  /** C# GetSampleForLargeRange（:96-104）。注意两次 InternalSample 的求值顺序 */
  private getSampleForLargeRange(): number {
    let num = this.internalSample();
    if (this.internalSample() % 2 === 0) num = -num;
    return (num + 2147483646) / 4294967293;
  }

  /** C# Next()（:106-108）：裸 int32 */
  next(): number {
    return this.internalSample();
  }

  /** C# Next(minValue, maxValue)（:115-133）：[min, max)。maxValue 负值时 C# 抛异常，
   *  本移植不抛（生成期契约保证入参合法）。*/
  nextIntRange(minValue: number, maxValue: number): number {
    const num = maxValue - minValue; // C# long 减法，≤2^32，JS 精确
    if (num <= 2147483647) {
      return (Math.trunc(this.sample() * num) + minValue) | 0;
    }
    return (Math.trunc(this.getSampleForLargeRange() * num) + minValue) | 0;
  }

  /** C# Next(maxValue)（:121-127）：[0, max) */
  nextInt(maxValue: number): number {
    return Math.trunc(this.sample() * maxValue);
  }

  /** C# NextDouble()（:113-115）*/
  nextDouble(): number {
    return this.sample();
  }

  /** C# Peek()（:88-99，非消耗）：下一 InternalSample 原始差值——对账/断点用 */
  peek(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    return this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
  }
}

class UR:
    def __init__(self, seed: int):
        sa = [0] * 56
        num = abs(seed) if seed != -2**31 else 2**31 - 1
        num2 = 161803398 - num
        sa[55] = num2
        num3 = 1
        for j in range(1, 55):
            num4 = 21 * j % 55
            sa[num4] = num3
            num3 = num2 - num3
            if num3 < 0:
                num3 += 2147483647
            num2 = sa[num4]
        for _k in range(1, 5):
            for l in range(1, 56):
                sa[l] -= sa[1 + (l + 30) % 55]
                if sa[l] < 0:
                    sa[l] += 2147483647
        self.sa = sa
        self.inext = 0

    def internal_sample(self) -> int:
        num = self.inext + 1
        if num > 55:
            num = 1
        num2 = num + 21
        if num2 > 55:
            num2 -= 55
        num3 = self.sa[num] - self.sa[num2]
        if num3 == 2147483647:
            num3 -= 1
        num3 = num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7FFFFFFF)
        self.sa[num] = num3
        self.inext = num
        return num3

    def sample(self) -> float:
        return self.internal_sample() * 4.656612875245797e-10

    def next(self, mn=None, mx=None):
        if mn is None:
            return self.internal_sample()
        if mx is None:
            return int(self.sample() * mn)
        return int(self.sample() * (mx - mn)) + mn


def samples_at(seed: int, k0: int, n: int):
    """返回从第 k0 掷开始的连续 n 个 raw internal_sample 值（0-based 掷序）。"""
    u = UR(seed)
    for _ in range(k0):
        u.internal_sample()
    return [u.internal_sample() for _ in range(n)]

263	/** GenAction.Apply 第 i 步 @ (x,y),失败短路返回 false(不执行后续步骤、不耗 RNG) */
264	function applyChain(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, steps: ChainStep[], i: number, x: number, y: number): boolean {
265	  if (i >= steps.length) return true;
266	  const s = steps[i];
267	  switch (s.k) {
268	    case 'dither':
269	      // Modifiers.cs:630-635:NextDouble() >= _failureChance 才 UnitApply
270	      return rng.next() >= s.p && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
271	    case 'blotches': {
272	      rng.next();                                                    // 丢 1 掷(Modifiers.cs:132)
273	      if (rng.next() < s.chance) {                                   // 成斑判定(:133)
274	        const x0 = rng.int(1 - s.minX, 0);                           // Next(1-minX, 1)(:136)
275	        const x1 = rng.int(0, s.maxX - 1);                           // Next(0, maxX)(:137)
276	        const y0 = rng.int(1 - s.minY, 0);                           // Next(1-minY, 1)(:138)
277	        const y1 = rng.int(0, s.maxY - 1);                           // Next(0, maxY)(:139)
278	        let ok = true;                                               // flag |= !UnitApply(:140-145)
279	        for (let dx = x0; dx <= x1; dx++) {
280	          for (let dy = y0; dy <= y1; dy++) {
281	            if (!applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x + dx, y + dy)) ok = false;
282	          }
283	        }
284	        return ok;
285	      }
286	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);                // 未成斑原点继续(:148)
287	    }
288	    case 'onlyTiles': {
289	      if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) return false;                         // !active → Fail(:245)
290	      const t = st.type[st.idx(x, y)];
291	      return s.types.includes(t) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);

297	    case 'skipTiles': {

const PRE_CLASS: Record<number, string> = { 65:'swords', 112:'magic', 186:'swords', 213:'swords', 218:'magic', 220:'spears', 274:'spears', 277:'spears', 280:'spears', 281:'guns', 284:'boom', 946:'swords', 964:'guns', 3019:'guns', 3069:'magic', 4061:'spears', 4062:'magic', 5011:'spears',

const PRE_REDUCED = new Set([7,8,9,10,11,22,23,24,29,30,31,39,40,56,41,47,48,49]);
function prefixRolls(rng, item): void {

        public static void CPBox(int x, int y)
        {
            try
            {
                var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder("CPB|" + x + "|" + y);
                for (int j = -1; j <= 2; j++)
                    for (int i = 0; i <= 1; i++)
                    {
                        var t = Terraria.Main.tile[x + i, y + j];
                        if (t == null) { sb.Append("|n"); continue; }
                        sb.Append("|" + t.type + "," + (t.active() ? 1 : 0) + "," + (t.halfBrick() ? 1 : 0) + "," + t.slope() + "," + t.liquid);
                    }
                System.IO.File.AppendAllText(ChestProbe.P(), sb.ToString() + "\n");
            }
            catch { }
        }
    }
}
